text: Which genes enriched or enhanced in thyroid gland stain moderately or strongly in thyroid glandular cells, have no detectable mRNA in liver, and are not enzymes?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Thyroid gland / Tissue enriched, Group enriched, Tissue enhanced AND Tissue expression (IHC): Thyroid gland / glandular cells / Medium, High AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected AND NOT Protein class: Enzymes
understanding: Identify genes that have enriched or enhanced RNA expression in the thyroid gland, display moderate or strong immunohistochemical staining (Medium or High) in thyroid glandular cells, have no detectable RNA expression in the liver, and are excluded from the enzyme protein class.

trail.requirement: genes enriched or enhanced in thyroid gland
trail.why: Selects thyroid gland at Level 1 and all categories representing enrichment or enhancement (Tissue enriched, Group enriched, and Tissue enhanced) at Level 2.

trail.requirement: stain moderately or strongly in thyroid glandular cells
trail.why: The requirement specifies moderate or strong staining in thyroid glandular cells, corresponding to Medium and High expression levels in the glandular cells of the thyroid gland.

trail.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in liver
trail.why: The requirement specifies no detectable mRNA in liver, which corresponds to selecting 'liver' at Level 1 and 'Not detected' at Level 2.
Selecting the class 'Enzymes' without subclass restrictions identifies all enzyme genes to be excluded as required.

requirements.requirement: genes enriched or enhanced in thyroid gland
requirements.why: This field defines RNA specificity categories (such as enriched or enhanced) per tissue type, including thyroid gland.

requirements.requirement: stain moderately or strongly in thyroid glandular cells
requirements.why: This field measures antibody staining (immunohistochemistry) across tissues, cell types (such as thyroid glandular cells), and expression levels (such as Medium and High).

requirements.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in liver
requirements.why: This field categorizes RNA distribution and specificity per tissue, including categories for genes not detected in a specific tissue such as the liver.
The question explicitly excludes enzymes, so this field is negated to remove genes belonging to the Enzymes class.
